request: Fix two harness contract defects found during unified-execution-roadmap: (T1) the memory_stop extractor is in a recursive noise loop, re-ingesting its own /memory-flush reports and firing on the literal phrase "the fix is…" in contract prose; (T2) integrate and simplify declare prereqs that are structurally unsatisfiable on the chore track.
novelty_evidence: Both tickets derive from landmines committed in 1414f27: .claude/memory/landmines.md -> memory-stop-extractor-recursive-noise-loop-on-the-fix-is-prose (T1) and chore-track-integrate-and-simplify-prereqs-are-structurally-unsatisfiable (T2). Evidence on disk, with live repro: _pending.md re-accumulated 9 candidates within one session of being flushed to zero.
track_reason: Human chose power over two lighter workflows with the real tradeoff disclosed (power costs 2 gates + a spec vs 2 gates + no spec). Buys: one written spec covering both fixes, security run PER TICKET (T1 edits a hook), and a single grant-commit landing an ordered two-commit split.

tickets.title: Stop the memory_stop extractor ingesting its own reports and contract prose
tickets.notes: DECISION_CUE_RE line 100 (`the\s+(?:fix|plan|approach)\s+is\b`) is unanchored and fires anywhere. Two failure modes: (a) skill/SKILL.md + CLAUDE.md contract text arrives as role:user, so instructional prose is tagged source:user-instruction; (b) Claude own /memory-flush report output is re-extracted as new candidates. Extends the EXISTING NOISE_PREFIXES mechanism — not greenfield. Hook edit => npm run build manifest rebuild (landmine: baseline-skill-edit-needs-manifest-rebuild). Art. VIII: user approval given; NO seed.md amendment needed — the §4.1 contract ("intent lines -> backlog") is unchanged, precedent 97b3e6d.

tickets.title: Reconcile integrate/simplify prereqs that no chore track can satisfy
tickets.notes: integrate requires security in completed|exceptions; simplify requires tdd in completed. The chore DAG has NO security node and tdd is always a chore exception, so both are unreachable. triage SOP contradicts chore SKILL on whether security is in the chore phase list. ACs MUST be diff-referenceable — do NOT put a process/outcome AC in the table (landmine: it wedges drift_check; has bitten twice).

tickets.title: chore runs security when the diff touches a sensitive glob; internal_phases makes the chore conditional set machine-readable
tickets.notes: Added by human decision at spec review (D11, resolves Q3). Without it, D3 would except `security` on chore while the chore skill runs it — exceptions claiming skipped while the phase executes. `internal_phases[]` on the track declaration is the fix: deriveExceptions subtracts it. Same drift class as T2 one level down (nothing on disk declares what a track may run internally, so the triage SOP and chore SKILL guess and contradict). rightsize-gate already refuses to skip security; chore now matches.

triage_correction: exceptions[] was written empty at triage; the power DAG has no intake/brd/scout/research/review nodes, so track_guard would block the spec write. Corrected before any phase ran. Same defect family as ticket T2 (a skill prereq demanding phases the track DAG cannot produce) — see spec Decisions.
